notes.title: Upcoming Changes
notes.content:
Hey everyone.

First of all, we'd like to thank all the players who tried the demo during Next Fest. Your feedback has been invaluable in improving the game, and now that we're finally starting to wrap up I'd like to talk about some of the changes resulting from it.

[h3]Fire Rate / Move Speed[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44893199/f15c04368007b59e49d6166e1f93413f3447f2ea.gif[/img]
We've increased the fire rate across the board for most weapons. This also includes adding on-screen bullet limiting, allowing higher damage when attacking enemies up close with certain weapons. Player move speed has also been increased. The game should feel much more fluid and 
responsive as a result. While some of these changes were planned as upgrades, it became clear that making the early game feel clunky was a poor choice.

[h3]Suggested Weapons[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44893199/f3238f0161e78c50bbb664ef2626a28d416c788c.png[/img]
The start of many areas now include weapons that you can optionally pick up. If you haven't crafted them yet, they'll still show up but you won't be able to equip them. This allows for a much smoother game flow where you can comfortably try new areas without having to rush back to town, or as a warning that you may not be ready yet. Player creativity is still encouraged, since not every ideal weapon is included and skilled players can often clear areas without any optimal weapons.

[h3]Gentler Introduction[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44893199/899b618d647f7293a8106a051582a2adcf267478.png[/img]
We've created a whole new, more straightforward stage 1 that encourages players to jump directly into the action while more gradually pulling them into the crafting and exploration side of things. We've also added some new puzzles to nudge players out of difficult areas, and placed more direct hints about how to use new weapons to unlock areas in the early parts of the game. If you enjoyed hunting down the secrets in the original demo, don't worry, there's still plenty to find. We're just trying to show new players how the game is structured before removing the guard rails.

[h3]And More[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44893199/1b571888d3edc220638cbb7de09cd215c4a5e8fd.png[/img]
There are also plenty of other major and minor changes, such as looping weapon cycling, but for now I think this is a decent overview of the biggest changes. If you want to see more new weapons and stages, we post video clips of how the game is developing over on our [url=https://bsky.app/profile/crabattackgames.bsky.social]Bluesky[/url] and [url=https://x.com/CrabAttackGames]Twitter[/url] as well.

Thanks for following us, see you next time.

notes.title: Demo V12
notes.content:
In response to feedback, we tried to make the first time experience a little smoother.

Changes:
[list]
[*] Tree top area now requires the Angler to enter.
[*] Help screen added, more explicitly explaining the flow of the game. It also shows up when starting a new file.
[*] Forest area's cave visually changed to look more like a wall.
[*] Renamed equipment menu to shop.
[*] Replaced "new item" sidebar list with notification icons directly on the return to town button as well as the town's shop button.
[*] Light shell is now only -1 HP instead of -5.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44893199/b4b7f83d6d6774d33f2d8c01bcd85e1a4c1eaddf.png[/img]

notes.title: Demo Now Available
notes.content:
The Crab Attack June Next Fest demo is available now. Four challenging bosses, over ten pieces of equipment, two difficulty settings, and your new best crab friend await.

A few extra notes:
[list]
[*]Testers have reported that the game runs great on Steam Deck.
[*]We plan on leaving the demo up after Next Fest, so take your time.
[*]This is a work in progress. There are still a few rough edges, but we felt it was far enough along to start getting feedback. We look forward to shaping the game together.
[*]Be sure to share your thoughts on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/uap5qFkGt6]Discord[/url] or [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2831900/discussions/1/]Forums[/url].
[/list]
